source: skills/short-form-video-script/references/script-anatomy-and-templates.md: Worked planning case — courier enters a folding doorway (revision 2026-09-20)
evidence_kind: synthetic software-test attestations, not model-generated media or visual-quality evidence

story.desire: Courier Mira wants her ringing red parcel silenced.
story.action: Mira carries the parcel fully through a paper clinic doorway.
story.consequence: Inside, Mira discovers the parcel is the patient and places it on the table.
story.payoff: Dr. Sen examines the unchanged parcel and says It needs a nap. Ringing stops; the parcel snores.

invariants: Mira and Dr. Sen retain their identities, body counts and clothing.
Exactly one red parcel exists; it never becomes another body or creature.
Mira owns the parcel through entry; placement visibly transfers it to the table; it stays there through payoff.

shots.initial_state: Mira outside, parcel in both hands; paper doorway visibly wide enough.
shots.dominant_action: Mira braces the doorway and crosses fully with the parcel during seconds 2–6.5.
shots.completed_end_state: Both feet, torso and parcel entirely beyond threshold; empty doorway held through second 8.

transition.rationale: Exterior completed entry cuts to new interior establishing composition; never interpolate between the two locations.

shots.initial_state: New interior wide: Mira holds the parcel, Dr. Sen stands beside an empty table.
shots.dominant_action: Mira places the parcel on the table and releases both hands during seconds 1–4.
shots.completed_end_state: Parcel rests alone on the table, hands visibly clear; Mira points at it.

transition.rationale: Cut closer on the same table; same identities and completed transfer persist.

shots.initial_state: Same parcel on table, Sen holds stethoscope, empty-handed Mira visible screen left.
shots.dominant_action: Sen touches the parcel with the instrument, listens, and diagnoses; parcel stops ringing and snores.
shots.completed_end_state: Contact shown, ringing stopped, audible snore, both actors react and hold; parcel remains unchanged.

transition.rationale: Standalone ending with readable reaction hold; no additional shot.
